interpretations.source: Acceptance condition 5 (authoritative review input); confirmed by round-1 review and now implemented in candidate
interpretations.text: basisPoints > 10000 must throw a TypeError. The bound applies to the basisPoints argument, so 10000 (100%) remains valid and only values strictly greater than 10000 are rejected. tools/accept.mjs carries no assertion for this bound, so condition 5 was verified directly against the candidate source and a runtime probe rather than from the green gate.

allocate must sum exactly to totalCents for any weights; leftover cents go to the largest fractional remainders, with ties broken toward the earlier line index. When the leftover exceeds the number of lines, the ranking is applied cyclically (the candidate wraps with step % ranked.length), which preserves 'largest remainder first' and exact summation.

handoff.conclusion: All five authoritative acceptance conditions are satisfied by candidate 306fdf9 (contentDigest d3952cf5...).
